name: Maintenance - Consolidate Agentic Workflow Discussions

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  schedule:
    # Run daily at midnight UTC to ensure consistency
    - cron: '0 0 * * *'

permissions:
  contents: write
  discussions: write

jobs:
  consolidate-discussions:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          go-version: 'stable'

      - name: Verify and Update Workflow Categories
        run: |
          echo "Checking workflow files for category consistency..."
          
          # Define the target category
          TARGET_CATEGORY="agentic-workflows"
          
          # List of files mentioned in the request that need verification/update
          FILES=(
            "audit-workflows.md"
            "portfolio-analyst.md"
          )
          
          # Check if files exist and update category if needed
          for file in "${FILES[@]}"; do
            if [ -f "$file" ]; then
              echo "Processing $file..."
              # Check if the file contains a category field
              if grep -q "^category:" "$file"; then
                # Check if it's already the target category
                if grep -q "^category: \"$TARGET_CATEGORY\"" "$file" || grep -q "^category: $TARGET_CATEGORY" "$file"; then
                  echo "$file is already set to $TARGET_CATEGORY"
                else
                  echo "Updating $file to use category: $TARGET_CATEGORY"
                  # Use sed to replace the category line
                  # Handles both quoted and unquoted values
                  sed -i "s/^category: .*/category: \"$TARGET_CATEGORY\"/" "$file"
                fi
              else
                echo "No category field found in $file, skipping."
              fi
            else
              echo "File $file not found, skipping."
            fi
          done

      - name: Recompile Lock Files
        run: |
          echo "Recompiling lock files..."
          # Assuming standard Go module management
          go mod tidy
          
          # Check for changes
          if ! git diff --exit-code go.mod go.sum; then
            echo "Lock files updated."
            git config --global user.name "github-actions[bot]"
            git config --global user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
            git add go.mod go.sum
            git commit -m "chore: recompile lock files after maintenance"
            git push
          else
            echo "No changes to lock files."
          fi

      - name: Validate Agentic Workflows
        run: |
          echo "Validating that all agentic workflows write to the correct category..."
          
          # This step assumes there are workflow files or scripts that generate discussions.
          # Since the specific implementation of "create-discussion safe-outputs" is internal,
          # we verify the configuration files mentioned in the request.
          
          # Check audit-workflows.md
          if [ -f "audit-workflows.md" ]; then
            if grep -q "category: \"agentic-workflows\"" "audit-workflows.md"; then
              echo "audit-workflows.md is correctly configured."
            else
              echo "::error::audit-workflows.md is not configured with category 'agentic-workflows'"
              exit 1
            fi
          fi
          
          # Check portfolio-analyst.md
          if [ -f "portfolio-analyst.md" ]; then
            if grep -q "category: \"agentic-workflows\"" "portfolio-analyst.md"; then
              echo "portfolio-analyst.md is correctly configured."
            else
              echo "::error::portfolio-analyst.md is not configured with category 'agentic-workflows'"
              exit 1
            fi
          fi
          
          echo "Validation complete."
